key_insight: FlahyRecovery uses AI and gene expression to classify tumors into three immune subtypes associated with survival and immunotherapy response.
clinical_relevance: This immune-profiling biomarker could support precision oncology research and treatment stratification, but it is not a drug discovery system or a validated treatment recommendation tool.
method: Annotated 7,424 tumor specimens across 14 cancers as Elevated (Hot), Suppressed (Cold), or Moderate (Intermediate) Immunity.
Trained and tested a supervised classifier using expression of 1,275 immune-related genes.
Evaluated immune-subtype classification in a multi-tumor validation cohort.
evidence_signal: In 1,337 validation specimens, the model achieved 79% sensitivity, 89% specificity, and a one-vs-rest AUC of 0.93 for immune subtyping.
watch_item: Subtype classification accuracy does not establish treatment benefit; prospective clinical utility and quantitative response-prediction results are not reported in the abstract.
paper_title: FlahyRecovery is an AI & gene expression based immune profiling biomarker for decision support in precision oncology
